passage:
uncertainty — 不确定性
A seminar on uncertainty in public claims was held last week at a community learning centre.

evaluate — 评估
The seminar was designed to help people evaluate claims they see in news reports, advertisements, and social media.

confidence level — 置信水平
A confidence level of 95% does not mean there is a 95% chance the claim is true; it means that if the study were repeated many times, 95% of the results would fall within a certain range.

distinction — 区别
This distinction was new to most participants.

analyse — 分析
They were divided into small groups and each group was given a short news article to analyse.

regulatory agency — 监管机构
A third group was asked to check if a claim about a medicine had been approved by a regulatory agency.

exaggerate — 夸大
She warned that headlines are often written to attract attention, so they may exaggerate or simplify the findings.

algorithms — 算法
Another participant asked about the role of social media algorithms.
